hashes_describe: Original source content before compatibility edits; origin revision defaults to v100_fork unless specified.

v100_plus/sglang_v100_plus/kernels/atten.adaptation: Only shared settings or the QSA combine function retained; ordinary paged MHA code omitted.
Only shared settings or the QSA combine function retained; ordinary paged MHA code omitted.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-block-fp8-.change: Explicit block-FP8 expert prefill with exact 128x128 scale reuse; generic per-column FP8 metadata remains supported.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-nvfp4.patc.change: Reduced NVFP4/FP8 SM70 build, preserving upstream bias support and build dependencies.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-prefill-ga.change: 64x256x32 NVFP4 gather caches live source rows per invocation and uses aligned 128-bit FP16 input loads; arithmetic, MMA, scales and public API are unchanged.

v100_plus/patches/marlin-v100-sm70-mxfp8.change: Native FP8 E4M3 group32 scale selection/dispatch for MXFP8 W8A16; preserve packed weights, full-K FP32 MMA accumulation and FP16 reconstructed operands/output.

attention_backend.contracts: FP16 KV/state, FP32 working accumulation; FP16 snapshot carry during verification; nonintrusive bounded FP32 prefill checkpoint copied into FP16 radix state; exact paired-query selected-key multiset, capacity-bounded device support preparation, up to 4096 selected columns; optional base-2 FP32 LSE for FP16 partial-attention DCP with FP32 correction/reduction; native H8/H16/H32/H64 sparse attention; resource-bounded H32/H64 prefill staging, native H64 head tiling and direct-Q decode for DCP4/DCP8

dense_fp8_decode.dispatch: SM70 only: PK<=256 uses one full-K Triton tile; four-row group32 projections with logical N>=2048,K>=1024 use vector CUDA; other shapes retain the existing SM70 Triton contraction.
dense_fp8_decode.contract: Original packed Marlin weight layout and group32/group128 FP16 scales; exact FP16 reconstructed operands and output; full-K FP32 working sums/partials; caller-owned capacity-bounded scratch, including padded logical widths and two-byte-offset scale views. No new quantization, checkpoint format, tuning flags or persistent expanded weights.
dense_fp8_decode.validation: Production/prototype results bit-exact on15 captured real FP8 banks; independent FP64 and prior implementation within unchanged rtol=.001,atol=.0002; graph replay with changed inputs/scales and canaries, registered numerical/graph/cancellation tests, memcheck and synccheck.

glm_paired_prefill.profile: GLM mHC4/4096, TP8/DCP4/EP1, single-session eager prefill, ordinary or EAGLE
glm_paired_prefill.contract: Same-layer KDA state and DSA key publication precede the next chunk; owned metadata/mHC/forward flags, one compute stream and a per-pair communication stream; FP16 KV/state boundaries and global TP sums preserved. Active paired forwards use replicated mHC PRE with the existing exact fused full-row cast/mean, avoiding two local gathers per PRE; other prefill layouts keep their partition choice.
glm_paired_prefill.validation: Bit-exact whole-model outputs and KDA/conv state on all eight ranks with fixed selected-key order; exact full/sharded mHC results on both captured stage banks, full-range changed-input graph/canary and memcheck checks; live-indexer three-category throughput, image input,15.8K continuation, prefix reuse and CPU ownership/compile regressions.

glm_fp4_local.implementation: Indexed nested-shard completion and block-scale normalization; lossless CPU CSF32 expansion before TP slicing; native SM70 MXFP8 group32 W8A16; fixed FP16 MLA / FP32 indexer projection boundaries; original quantized weights and global calibration preserved.
glm_fp4_local.status: Validated TP8/DCP4 ordinary/MTP3, images and prefix reuse with FP16 KV/state. Own NVFP4 MTP required. Full1M runtime completed on2026-10-22; current hosting/development target524288. Comprehensive long-context numerical/quality evaluation is separate.
